notes.title: Official Community Discord !!!
notes.content:
In order to make everyone play games together, we created a channel on Discord.             

Check out the [url=https://discord.gg/s65x6B] Official Community Discord here !!!![/url]            

If you're new to discord, it's basically a Chat Server where communities can come together. It's not required that you join the Discord, but it is highly recommended.            

If you have any additional comments or questions, feel free to post them below.

notes.title: Hello, pilots! Welcome to Code51: Mecha Arena!
notes.content:
This is Smellyriver game studio. Code51: Mecha Arena is the first VR game we made. As a group of fans of mecha movies and games, when we met the first generation of VR devices we decided to build a mecha driving and fighting game in VR. 

So after two years of development, Code51: Mecha Arena comes out. In which you can play as a pilot, sit in the cockpit, drive powerful mecha and fight with other guys. Just like Gouda, EVA, Pacific Rim and so on. But we want it more close to reality, so we made it a post-apocalyptic wasteland style.

We really hope you guys can enjoy the mecha driving experience and become skillful pilots！

If you want to communicate with us, you can find us on Twitter: @smellyriver.
